name: Volt Typhoon - TTPs & Detection Coverage v4 (Endpoint + Edge + Registry)
description: MITRE ATT&CK v19.1 Navigator layer for Volt Typhoon. v4 adds the registry-layer detection pack (DeviceRegistryEvents / Sysmon 12-14): PortProxy rule creation, Defender & security-service tamper, audit/event-log disable, NTDS & VSS footprint, autorun, service install, scheduled task, WinRM and RDP enablement, plus a weighted registry-only kill-chain capstone. Closes the Persistence and Defense Impairment blind spots. Scores: 3=high-fidelity/capstone, 2=single-phase detection, 1=hunting only/partial, 0=blind spot.

metadata.name: Aliases
metadata.value: BRONZE SILHOUETTE, Vanguard Panda, DEV-0391, UNC3236, Voltzite, Insidious Taurus

metadata.name: Target Sectors
metadata.value: US critical infrastructure - communications, energy, transportation, water

metadata.name: Signature TTP
metadata.value: Living-off-the-Land (LOTL), no custom malware, KV-botnet relay

metadata.name: Detection Pack
metadata.value: KQL v1+v2 endpoint pack + edge telemetry pack (CEF/NetFlow/DNS) + v4 registry pack

metadata.name: ATT&CK Version
metadata.value: v19.1 (April 2026 release with Defense Evasion split)

techniques.comment: Exploit Public-Facing Application. [v3 UPLIFT 0->2] Fortinet CVE-2022-42475 and Cisco RV320/325 exploit indicators now detected via CommonSecurityLog CEF ingestion - Edge Query 1 + Query 2.
External Remote Services. [v3 UPLIFT 0->2] VPN authentication from anomalous geography detected via Edge Query 3 against Fortinet/Ivanti/Cisco SSL-VPN logs.
Valid Accounts. [v3 UPLIFT 1->2] Cross-referenced with edge VPN auth telemetry for impossible-travel and credential-stuffing patterns.
Domain Accounts. [v3 UPLIFT] Now correlated across edge VPN auth + endpoint capstone.
Command and Scripting Interpreter - Discovery query catches cmd/wmic invocations.
PowerShell - covered by v2 Encoded PowerShell detection with multi-layer scoring.
Windows Command Shell - covered by Discovery and capstone queries.
WMI - Impacket wmiexec pattern (cmd spawned by wmiprvse + ADMIN$ output) is high-fidelity.
Scheduled Task. [v4 UPLIFT 1->2] TaskCache Tree/Tasks registry registration + Microsoft-folder masquerade detection (v4 Query 8).
Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder. [v4 UPLIFT 0->2] Run/RunOnce + Winlogon Userinit/Shell hijack detection via DeviceRegistryEvents (v4 Query 7).
WMI Event Subscription. BLIND SPOT - needs persistence query set.
Account Manipulation. [v3 UPLIFT 0->1] Partial coverage via edge config-change detection (Query 6) - catches privilege escalation on the edge device itself.
Local Accounts - account anomaly hunting.
Obfuscated Files or Information - covered by v2 Encoded PowerShell scoring rule. [v19: moved to Stealth]
Command Obfuscation - explicitly scored by Encoded PowerShell query. [v19: Stealth tactic]
Masquerading - .gif rename trick caught by FileRenamed query. [v19: Stealth tactic]
Match Legitimate Name or Location - archive renamed to image extension. [v19: Stealth]
Masquerade File Type - .dit hiding as .gif. [v19: Stealth]
System Binary Proxy Execution - wmic call create caught by capstone. [v19: Stealth tactic]
Hide Artifacts. Not specifically covered. [v19: Stealth tactic]
Indicator Removal. [v4 UPLIFT 0->2] Event-log channel / audit policy disable via registry detected (v4 Query 4).
Clear Windows Event Logs. [v4 UPLIFT 0->2] Per-channel WINEVT Enabled=0 and Autologger stop detected via registry (v4 Query 4).
Disable or Modify Tools. [v4 UPLIFT 0->2] Defender policy flips + WinDefend/Sense/WdNisSvc service Start=4 disable via registry (v4 Query 5). [v19: replaces retired T1562/.001/.006]
OS Credential Dumping - parent technique. Multiple sub-techniques covered.
NTDS - ntdsutil IFM detection is high-fidelity. THE signature Volt Typhoon detection.
DCSync - covered by v2 Event 4662 + Schema-Id-GUID query. Essentially zero false positives.
LSASS Memory - rundll32 comsvcs.dll MiniDump in alt-dump query. Other variants not covered.
Security Account Manager - reg save HKLM\SAM in alt-dump query.
LSA Secrets - reg save HKLM\SECURITY in alt-dump query.
Unsecured Credentials. Not covered.
Credentials from Password Stores. Not covered.
Account Discovery - net group/net localgroup caught by Discovery query.
Local Account discovery.
Domain Account - net group /dom and net group Domain Admins.
System Network Configuration Discovery - ip-api.com / ipinfo.io / ipconfig.
Remote System Discovery - nltest, net view. Partial coverage.
System Information Discovery - systeminfo, wmic logicaldisk.
Process Discovery - tasklist /svc.
System Network Connections Discovery - netstat. Partial coverage.
System Owner/User Discovery - query user, whoami.
Domain Groups - net group Domain Admins enumeration.
Remote Services - RDP/SMB usage. Partial.
SMB/Windows Admin Shares - Impacket pattern writing to ADMIN$.
Windows Remote Management. [v4 UPLIFT 1->2] WinRM AllowAutoConfig/TrustedHosts/weak-auth enablement via registry (v4 Query 9).
Lateral Tool Transfer - SMB copy. Partial via file events.
Archive Collected Data - 7zip/rar staging query.
Archive via Utility - 7z.exe, rar.exe with password (-mhe -p).
Data from Local System. Partial.
Proxy - netsh portproxy detection plus registry corroboration.
Internal Proxy - the signature Volt Typhoon TTP. High-fidelity coverage.
Multi-hop Proxy. [v3 UPLIFT 1->2] KV-botnet beaconing on port 8443 detected via NetFlow Edge Query 4.
Protocol Tunneling. [v3 UPLIFT 1->2] FRP/Earthworm tunneling detected via outbound 8443 anomaly + DNS DDNS query (Edge Queries 4 + 5).
Web Protocols. [v3 UPLIFT 0->1] Partial via DNS DDNS hunting (Edge Query 5) and outbound beaconing patterns.
Ingress Tool Transfer. Not covered.
Compromise Infrastructure. [v3 NEW] Partial via edge device config-drift detection (Query 6) catches compromised perimeter devices being repurposed.
Botnet. [v3 NEW] KV-botnet activity (Cisco/NETGEAR EOL SOHO routers, port 8443) partially detectable via NetFlow + EOL device watchlist (Edge Queries 4 + 7).
Exfil over C2 Channel. [v3 UPLIFT 0->1] Partial via NetFlow byte-volume anomalies on KV-botnet beaconing channels.
Exfil over Web Service. Not covered without proxy/NDR logs.

Modify Registry. [v4 NEW] CISA AA24-038A tags the netsh PortProxy registry modification as [T1112]; the v4 pack detects PortProxy, Defender, NTDS, audit, autorun, service, task, WinRM and RDP registry writes (v4 Queries 1-11).
Windows Service. [v4 NEW] Service ImagePath/ServiceDll written from staging paths or random-named keys, incl. PsExec service pattern (v4 Query 6).
Remote Desktop Protocol. [v4 NEW] RDP enabled (fDenyTSConnections=0) / NLA disabled via registry (v4 Query 10).
Disable Windows Event Logging. [v4 NEW] EventLog channel / Autologger / LSA audit weakening via registry (v4 Query 4). [v19: survives the T1562 split as standalone Defense Impairment technique]
